senses.definition: A place in the middle of something; may be used of a literal or metaphorical location.
senses.example: Miss Phyllis Morgan, as the hapless heroine dressed in the shabbiest of clothes, appears in the midst of a gay and giddy throng; she apostrophises all and sundry there, including the villain, and has a magnificent scene which always brings down the house, and nightly adds to her histrionic laurels.

senses.definition: Among, in the middle of; amidst.
senses.example: Mildred comes home from work early only to discover her husband, Robert, midst of a lewd affair with their neighbor, Gladys.
